sensor_full_foot.notes: Print flat sensor seat down, dome up. Three 2.4 mm blind sockets require only short bridges; no external supports expected. Physical fit untested.

sensor_reference.notes: User-measured 10 mm OD, 8.5 mm inner diameter, 6.5 mm tab. Film thickness and tab length illustrative.

mating_cylinder.notes: Print unnotched rim on bed, pins up. Sloped internal supports avoid horizontal boss overhangs. Use the matching v5 foot.

instructions.title: Assembly
instructions.text: Print both v5 parts. The cylinder pins enter sockets in the rounded bottom. Dry-fit, apply a small amount of glue, and slide together. Keep adhesive off sensor and wire tab.
